RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 60

An all-male panel is common in structural engineering, but demographic homogeneity significantly increases the risk of affinity bias. When combined with a substantial experience gap, reliance on subjective criteria ("client relationships"), and unanswered feedback requests, gender may well have influenced the evaluation.

However, raising the panel's gender composition directly with the firm right now is risky. Accusing them of bias prematurely can trigger defensiveness and close doors before you have clarity. Instead, follow up professionally to obtain your written feedback and document all interactions. If you decide to pursue a formal discrimination complaint, consult an employment lawyer or professional body first to evaluate your options.
